definitions.depth: Horizontal passer-to-intended-endpoint distance. Through endpoint is aim ray plus 0.55 s runner projection, normalized to requested depth. A short request behind a runner is visibly flagged.
definitions.actualEndpoint: Through: first descending-speed crossing of 1.2 m/s. Cross: perpendicular target plane crossing. A missed plane is null.
definitions.actualIdealDepth: Through measured depth where speed reaches 1.2 m/s; Cross horizontal range at target-plane crossing.
definitions.bend: Maximum absolute perpendicular departure from direct origin-to-target line before ideal target arrival.
definitions.spin: Cross sidespin follows 56×(Curve/75)^2.7 exactly plus fixed 8 rad/s backspin; total vector magnitude also reported.
definitions.swing: Attack direction +x; right-foot/right-side and left-foot/left-side outswing, opposite side inswing.
